title: UL-08 — Challenge: Application Load Balancer
scenario: Associate AWS WAF with your ALB lab after pricing review; prove a rule fires; remove WAF before ALB teardown.
acceptanceCriteria: Name the resources you create `workbook-ul08`: ALB `workbook-ul08`, target group `workbook-ul08-tg`, VPC `workbook-ul08`, security group `workbook-ul08-sg`, and WAF web ACL `workbook-ul08`. Tag each one LabId=ul-08.

Application Load Balancer from GL-08 pattern exists and serves HTTP. It uses two public subnets in different Availability Zones (for example us-east-1a and us-east-1b), both tagged LabId=ul-08 and associated with the public route table.
AWS WAF web ACL is associated with the ALB after you record WAF pricing.
One WAF managed rule group is attached (AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet or similar).
Test request shows blocked or counted action for a deliberate bad request.
WAF association is removed before ALB delete.
Web ACL is deleted after disassociation.
ALB and targets teardown same day.
HTTP listener only for lab (no TLS cert purchase).
Teardown order documented: WAF, listener, ALB, TG, EC2.
Public IPv4 released if allocated standalone.

hints.text: WAF bills per web ACL and rules.
Use curl.exe with bad User-Agent to trigger managed rule.

stopChargesPanel: Disassociate the WAF web ACL from the ALB and delete the web ACL, then delete the listener, ALB, target group, EC2 instance, Elastic IP (if allocated), both public subnets and their route table, the IGW, the SG and the VPC for ul-08. Forgotten 24 h ≈ $1.26 (a floor; see the cost basis).

orderedDeletesPowerShell: # Uses: $WebAclName, $WebAclId, $AlbArn, $ListenerArn, $TargetGroupArn, $InstanceId, $AllocationId, $VpcId, $SubnetPub, $SubnetPub2, $IgwId, $PublicRouteTableId, $RtAssocPub, $RtAssocPub2, $SgId (the IDs you set while building; unset ones are skipped)
# Lost an ID? Resources are named workbook-ul08*; list what is tagged with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-08

if ($WebAclId -and $WebAclName) { $LockToken = aws wafv2 get-web-acl --name $WebAclName --scope REGIONAL --id $WebAclId --query LockToken --output text; aws wafv2 delete-web-acl --name $WebAclName --scope REGIONAL --id $WebAclId --lock-token $LockToken }
if ($AlbArn) { aws elbv2 delete-load-balancer --load-balancer-arn $AlbArn; aws elbv2 wait load-balancers-deleted --load-balancer-arns $AlbArn }
if ($InstanceId) { aws ec2 terminate-instances --instance-ids $InstanceId; aws ec2 wait instance-terminated --instance-ids $InstanceId }
if ($IgwId -and $VpcId) { aws ec2 detach-internet-gateway --internet-gateway-id $IgwId --vpc-id $VpcId; aws ec2 delete-internet-gateway --internet-gateway-id $IgwId }
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-08 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
aws wafv2 list-web-acls --scope REGIONAL does not list your web ACL name
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-08 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-08. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources. Load balancer network interfaces can linger for a minute or two after the waiter returns: if a subnet, internet gateway or security group delete returns DependencyViolation, wait 1–2 minutes and rerun Stop charges from that line.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-08) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.

Cost basis (us-east-1, priced 2026-09-29): 1 ALB* $0.0225/h billed in full hours, 2 public IPv4 on the ALB (one per subnet/AZ) $0.005/h each, t3.micro $0.0104/h target with no public IPv4 (the lab's subnets do not auto-assign one), 8 GB gp3* root at $0.08/GB-month, AWS WAF web ACL* $5.00/month and one managed rule group* $1.00/month, both prorated hourly (requests at $0.60 per million excluded); an optional standalone Elastic IP is not included; * worked-example rate whose region the page does not name: rate not verified on 2026-09-29; re-check the pricing page before running; same-hour ≈ $0.09, forgotten 24 h ≈ $1.26. This is a floor: it excludes data transfer and LCU/usage charges. Re-read the pricing page before you run the lab.
